name: SP1 — Sanitize invalid ElementRefs in assembly fallback path

scenarios.name: Sanitize-01 fallback nullifies unresolvable ElementRef in each ref field

steps.text: a valid ResponsibilitySet from Call 2a with responsibility RESP-1
the ResponsibilitySet has a <element_type> <element_id> with <ref_field> {type: <ref_type>, id: <ref_id>}
a ControlElementSet from Call 2b with an unresolvable feedback source reference
the Stage 2 assembly with fallback is executed
a ControlStructure model is produced
the <element_type> <element_id> <ref_field> is None
the pipeline does not crash

scenarios.name: Sanitize-04 valid ElementRefs are preserved during sanitization

steps.text: a valid ResponsibilitySet from Call 2a with responsibility RESP-1 and a ControlElementSet from Call 2b with controlled process CP-1
the ResponsibilitySet has a <element_type> <element_id> with <ref_field> pointing to CP-1
a ControlElementSet from Call 2b with an unresolvable feedback source reference

steps.text: a valid ResponsibilitySet from Call 2a with responsibility RESP-1 and a ControlElementSet from Call 2b with controlled process CP-1

a ControlElementSet from Call 2b with an unresolvable feedback source reference

scenarios.name: Sanitize-06 stripped references are logged in warnings
